data.name: Private Luxury Yacht Rental (12 Person Max)
data.headline: 47 Ft Private Yacht Rental- (Bareboat Charter)
data.description:
Take in the beautiful views of the Chicago skyline, shoreline, and riverfront from your private chartered yacht. 

(CAPTAIN IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE PRICE AND MUST BE PAID SEPARATELY)

meeting_point.address: 1115 West Division Street Chicago, IL US 60642

data.what_is_included:
- The top deck has a canopy optional flybridge with padded bench seating and a table right behind the captain seat with 360 unobstructed views.

- Mid-deck has a  kitchen area with a fridge, wet bar, and an entertainment area with plenty of seating and a table for food, 2 bathrooms, and 2 separate sleeping areas
- Swim platform with ladder
- Excellent sound system
- Life jackets  and safety equipment
- 2 coolers on board
- BYOB and Food

Our Three-Hour charter on the Chicago River and pricing is listed by date.

5-hour charters on Lake Michigan/Playpen are available.

Fireworks are Wednesday and Saturday nights on The Chicago River

Before reserving, please read through the rules and Coast Guard regulations.  You will also be required to fill out a waiver 

##50% Deposit is required at the time of booking to reserve the yacht.

The maximum number of people is 12 (plus captain and crew) There are no exceptions.

You may BYOB and food
There will be one large cooler on board and a refrigerator. 
Please bring ice as there is no ice on board
data.what_is_not_included: The captain must be booked separately and is $100 per hour.  Once your deposit is made,  the available captain will call you within 48 hours.
data.cancellation_notes:
50% Deposit is due at booking. The final payment is due one week before the event and will be charged automatically. We do not offer refunds or cancellations.  

The yacht will go out rain or shine. Please ensure you have read through all policies before booking.  There are no refunds or cancellations.
data.booking_notes:
Your reservation is confirmed. Please contact Captain Joe at 630-707-0626 and setup a deposit for your captain fee.
The captain fee is $100 per hour.


Please ensure you have no more than twelve people total.  A driver's license or state ID of the person booking must be shown when checking in.
